news.headline: Enhancing Your Off-Duty Employment Experience with OfficerTRAK®
Enhancing Your Agency’s Oversight and Efficiency in Off-Duty Employment with OfficerTRAK®
Enhancing Security Partnerships: How OfficerTRAK® Benefits Businesses, Organizations, and Community Partners

paragraphs: Off Duty Management administers off-duty work programs for law enforcement agencies, their officers, and community businesses. Its OfficerTRAK® platform handles Police, Fire, or EMS off-duty job requests. Officers clock in and out, view job history, and get real-time notifications in the OfficerTRAK® app. The businesses hiring officers request shifts, receive invoices, and pay online through a portal.

Off Duty Management charges nothing to agencies and officers. It takes on the financial risk of late or non-payment by the off-duty employer, and says officers and agencies are paid weekly regardless of customer payment status. The company reports partnering with over 200 primary agencies and 300 backup agencies across the nation.

In Arizona, it deploys trained SSO officers across jurisdictions to help school districts fill School Safety Officer shifts. The Arizona Department of Education sets a curriculum officers must complete to be eligible for those shifts. Superintendent Tom Horne extended that partnership with Off Duty Management through 2026. Retired Austin Police Chief Brian Manley joined the company as President.

quote.text: Off Duty Management Automates Off-Duty Work for Agencies, Officers, and Customers.
